primary: Fixed probe/judge50 pipeline; original paired-valid support, design weights and macro averaging. Supplement direct judge50 and three existing shared-anchor threshold policies.
learner: One pooled gate per outcome judge and policy. Regularized logistic C0.1 or1; decision tree depth3 or5 with min_samples_leaf50. No kNN: low-dimensional tabular pilot, mixed feature scales and sparsely observed disagreements.
supervision: Use validation cases where original control and NN binary decisions disagree. Target1 if NN correct,0 if control correct. Equal original cell mass with inverse-inclusion weights. Unchanged outcomes indifferent and excluded from fitting, included in F1 selection.
features: Explicit whitelist of pre-judge retrieval/probe statistics and dataset/backbone identity. No target gold, original judge outputs, mechanism annotations, target IDs or test-distribution ranks as inputs. See features.json.
selection: Three target-text-grouped folds, seeded deterministic hash, shared across all judges. Out-of-fold gate predictions for all validation cases. For each candidate and cell, choose gate threshold maximizing weighted validation pipeline F1, including always/never; ties fewer NN then higher cutoff. Choose candidate per judge/policy by mean cell validation F1, exact ties earlier simpler candidate. Also freeze best model within each family for comparison. Scaler fitted within training fold only. Refit selected models on all eligible validation disagreements. Persist frozen choices before test evaluation.
benchmarks: Original alwaysNN, control and original per-cell validation-selected cosine gates, identical probe/judge cutoffs and test support. Semantic-label gate not a model feature.
limits: Exploratory analysis on previously inspected test data. No inference/model calls or probe retraining. Gate uses known neighbour training label, not unknown target label. No claim of unbiased CV score after model/cutoff selection; held-out test reports actual performance.
